_meta.description: Root configuration for the OneDrive Brain system. Read this first to understand the folder structure, categories, and rules for interacting with brain files.

categories.description: Home and family knowledge — physical items, maintenance, service contacts
Active project state, decisions, and session handoffs. One subfolder per project.
Reading list, skill development, research notes

agent_rules.path_format: All paths use forward slashes. No spaces in any path or filename. Kebab-case only. All lowercase.
agent_rules.id_format: UUIDv4 for all entry IDs. Never reuse an ID.
agent_rules.update_protocol: Read the file, find the entry by ID, update in place, write the full file back. Never append a duplicate.
agent_rules.new_entry_protocol: Generate a new UUIDv4 ID. Set created and last_modified to current UTC time. Append to the entries array.
agent_rules.never_delete: Entries are never deleted. Set status to archived instead.
agent_rules.quote_all_paths: Always wrap file paths in quotes in any shell command or script. The OneDrive root path may contain spaces even though brain paths do not.
